senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of רוח)to soften; to poultice.
to strike a plaster, rub a salve; in gen. to mash, crush.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:6">Tosef. Sabb. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:6">VI</cite>), 6 <he>המְמָרֵחַ בשבת</he> he who mashes ingredients for a plaster on the Sabbath; <cite ref="Eruvin 102b:10">Erub. 102ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. X, 26ᶜ.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:3">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>הממ׳ רטיה וכ׳</he> he who spreads and presses the poultice over a sore; Y. ib. VII, 10ᵈ top. Ib. XXII, 3 (146ᵃ) he must not put on wax <he>מפני שהוא ממרח</he> (Mish. Pes. <he>מַמְרִיחַ</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) because it is an act resembling the spreading of plaster. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 8, ch. X; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:11">Kel. V, 11</cite> <he>מֵרְחָהּ בטיט</he> if he smeared clay over it; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:12">12</cite>.
Ib. VII, 10 ומי׳ שפתותיה עם הכותל and connected its rims with the wall by plaster or pitch; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמוֹרָח crushed.
Bekh. 44ᵇ האי ממ׳ אשך וכ׳ (not ממרוח) if m’roaḥ meant crushed, it ought to read m’moraḥ &c.; Yalk. Lev. 632, v. מְרוֹחַ.

senses.gloss: to pass (the hand) over a viscid mass, to wipe off, rub off. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. מְמָרְחוֹ בידו אחת he may wipe (or brush) it off with one hand; (Bab.
to give a pile of grain an even shape, to finish the process of storing up.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:6">Maasr. I, 6</cite> <he>משיְמָרֵחַ ואם אינו מְמָרֵחַ וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>מְמָרֵיחַ</he> or <he>מַמְרִיחַ</he>) (is subject to tithes) as soon as he evens the pile, and if he does not even &c.; expl. Y. ib. I, 49ᵃ bot. <he>מן דו ישפר וכ׳</he> when he gives a finish to the surface of the pile. Ib. <he>בשאין בדעתו למָרֵחַ</he> (not <he>לימרח</he>) when he has not the intention to even the pile; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְמוֹרָח</he>, f. <he>מְמוֹרַחַת</he>; pl. <he>מְמוֹרָחִין</he>; <he>מְמוֹרָחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 11a:22">Bekh. 11ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>טבלים ממ׳</he> (Ar. <he>מְרוּחִים</he>) untithed grain stored up in proper shape. Y. Peah IV, 16ᶜ bot. <he>כרי ממ׳</he> a finished pile; a. e.—

senses.gloss: (denom. of רַחַת) to winnow. Part. pass. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 2:17">Tosef. Maasr. II, 17</cite> <he>מצא תבואה ממ׳ עשויה כרי וכ׳</he> if one finds winnowed grain (which has been abandoned), if it is made up into a pile, you dare not take it, opp. <he>מפוזרת</he> scattered; Y. ib. III, 50ᶜ bot. <he>פירות ממורחין</he>.

senses.gloss: to be crushed into a viscid mass.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5">Bekh. VII, 5</cite> (expl. <he>מרוח אשך</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>כל שנִמְרְחוּ אשכיו</he> (Bab. ed., 44ᵇ, <he>נימחו</he>) whose testicles are crushed; (refuted ib. in Ib.) <he>האי ממורח וכ׳</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 10</cite> <he>עד שתִּמָּרֵחַ עם השפה</he> until it is smeared over so as to be even with the rim.

senses.gloss: to be shaped into an even pile, to be finished. Y. Peah I, beg. 15ᵃ עד שלא נתמ׳ הכר as long as the pile is not struck off; a. e. [Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ bot. תבואה משיתמרח, read: משימרח, v. supra.]
